commit.subject: LU-20496 efalnd: Make daemon cleanup conn Tx self contained
commit.message:
LU-20496 efalnd: Make daemon cleanup conn Tx self contained

Move abort Tx draining and pend Tx cancellation into cleanup conn Tx
function so it handles all TX cleanup internally. This simplifies the
drain conn function which now only calls cleanup conn and checks the
destroy condition.

Test-Parameters: trivial
